summary: Dead Space franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Dead Space

primary.why: The original Dead Space released on Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, and Windows. The 2023 remake is a separate entry, so the best route for preserving the original game is the Windows release with PC fixes applied.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Windows version and apply community fixes for input, frame pacing, and compatibility before capture. Play the 2023 remake as its own entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate this row with the 2023 remake; use the remake entry for the reimagined version.

entries.title: Dead Space: Extraction

emulation.notes: Prefer original PS3 hardware with Move if available.

primary.why: Extraction released first on Wii, then received a PlayStation 3 port bundled with Dead Space 2 and supporting PlayStation Move. The PS3 version is the higher-fidelity official route for this rail-shooter prequel.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PlayStation 3 version with Move support if available. Use Wii only for original motion-control comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Rail-shooter spin-off/prequel, not a port of the 2008 Dead Space.

entries.title: Dead Space Ignition

emulation.emulator: Xenia or RPCS3 only for preservation testing
emulation.notes: Prefer owned Xbox route if available.

primary.why: Dead Space Ignition released on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 as a downloadable puzzle/action prequel. Xbox is the preferred archive route because the Xbox store listing and backward-compatibility path are still publicly documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Xbox 360/Xbox backward-compatible route if owned. Use PS3 only if Xbox access is unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: Downloadable spin-off; availability may depend on account ownership and storefront/backward-compatibility status.

entries.title: Dead Space 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows main campaign plus Xbox 360 Severed DLC as secondary

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Xenia only for preservation testing of Severed
emulation.notes: Native Windows for main campaign; Xbox route for Severed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC campaign plus Xbox DLC capture

primary.why: Dead Space 2 released on Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360. Windows is the highest-fidelity main-campaign route, but the Severed story DLC was not released on PC, so Xbox is kept as a secondary route for Severed only.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version for the main campaign. Then use the Xbox 360/Xbox backward-compatible Dead Space 2: Severed DLC only for the two extra story chapters.

secondary.exclusive_content: Dead Space 2: Severed two-chapter story DLC, absent from PC.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only Severed after the Windows main campaign.
secondary.why: Severed is not available on PC; the DLC is available on the Xbox store.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing this route is logged; Severed remains a console-only content caveat.

entries.title: Dead Space

primary.why: The mobile Dead Space is a distinct 2011 spin-off set between Dead Space and Dead Space 2, released on iOS, Android, BlackBerry PlayBook, and BlackBerry 10. It has been removed from mobile storefronts, so the iOS release is the archival target rather than a normal current purchase route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available. Otherwise preserve captures and metadata rather than claiming normal current access.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile spin-off, not a port of the 2008 game; removed from mobile storefronts.

entries.title: Dead Space 3

primary.version: Original PC release with Awakened DLC
primary.why: Dead Space 3 released on Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360. Windows is the highest-fidelity main route, and the Awakened DLC is available on the PC/Origin route as well as consoles.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version with the Awakened DLC installed. Verify co-op/online service state before documenting co-op content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify current co-op/online service state before capture.

entries.title: Dead Space

primary.why: The 2023 Dead Space remake is a distinct Motive Studio remake released on Windows, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route because it has the strongest capture/settings ceiling and a well-documented PC version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version of the 2023 remake through Steam or EA app. Keep this separate from the 2008 original entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Distinct remake entry; do not overwrite or merge the 2008 original-game row.
